title: What Walking Humbly Actually Looks Like When No One's Grading It
caption:
Walking humbly with God gets read as staying quiet, staying small, never taking the compliment. Micah 6:8 never asked for that.

Humility isn't a volume setting. It's an accurate read on who you are before God, which means you can take a compliment without deflecting it, take correction in front of people without getting defensive, and stop quietly ranking every room you walk into.

He has told you, O man, what is good: to do justice, love kindness, and walk humbly with your God (Micah 6:8).

Stop measuring the room. Start measuring yourself against Him.
